# Diego De Pablo

> Full-stack software engineer specializing in large-scale data management, federated data spaces, and AI applications.

Diego De Pablo is a software engineer based in Málaga, Spain, working at Khaos Research (University of Málaga) and building modern web applications, distributed pipelines, and AI systems.

## Key Projects

- [MetaDataXtract](https://github.com/KhaosResearch/MetaDataXtract): Automatic metadata extraction pipeline supporting 30+ scientific data formats.
- [MetaDataSearch](https://github.com/KhaosResearch/metadataSearchTool): Semantic search and retrieval system powered by LLMs for distributed data catalogs.
- [AlignX](https://github.com/KhaosResearch/AlignX): Intelligent alignment and reconciliation tool for federated data space schemas.
- [mSurgery Platform](https://msurgery.com/): Immersive telepresence and surgical collaboration system.
- [Kubernetes GitOps Platform](https://github.com/Diegodepab): Production-grade microservices deployment with Argo CD, Helm, and Envoy Gateway.
- [Patient Monitoring IoT](https://github.com/Diegodepab): Real-time biomedical telemetry streaming and alert platform.
